selection_rule: Prior to new solver outcomes: low/high homogeneous views plus two distinct heterogeneous views
comparability: Full must be freshly rerun on the same new host as model ablations; original 900s full host differs
random_siu_rule: At each checkpoint, if directed SIUs are legal choose single/directed with equal probability; choose a legal family uniformly, then a legal binding uniformly. RNG seeded from run seed.
single_op_rule: Restrict the current finite plan registry to its existing nine single-operation plans; keep observation, provider and execution otherwise shared.
no_struct_rule: Keep the full current legal plan registry, current telemetry and historical numeric outcomes; mask resource witnesses, target-specific blocker descriptors, plan contexts and previous free-text choice hypotheses/evidence in the model payload.
paired_unit: same graph_id, seed and host across arms
primary_outcome: independently verified integer MWIS value_ticks at 900 s
